record.paper_title: Graph Partitions: Recent Progresses and Some Open Problems
record.original_question: Does every planar graph with n vertices admit a bisection (S, T) whose cut size e(S, T), the number of edges with one endpoint in each part, is at most n?

evidence.quote: There are still some interesting minimum bisection problems particularly on special families of graphs. Here below is a still open folklore conjecture on the minimum bisection of planar graphs.

Conjecture 3.2[28] Every planar graph of order n has a bisection (S, S¯) such that e(S, S¯) ≤
n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let G be a finite simple planar graph on n vertices. A bisection of G is an ordered partition (S, T) of the vertex set V(G) with ||S| - |T|| ≤ 1. Let e(S, T) denote the number of edges of G with one endpoint in S and the other in T.

Prove or disprove: every planar graph G on n vertices admits a bisection (S, T) such that
    e(S, T) ≤ n.
artifact.status_search_result: The statement is a folklore conjecture in graph partitioning. It has been verified for restricted subclasses of planar graphs (e.g., plane triangulations, where a minimum balanced bipartition with at most n cut edges has been shown to exist, with both parts inducing connected near-triangulations) and analogous O(n) or improved bounds are known for planar graphs without separating triangles, but no proof for all planar graphs has been published as of 2025.

status_evidence.title: On Alliance Partitions and Bisection Width for Planar Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Folklore conjecture: for any planar graph G, a minimum balanced bipartition (V1,V2) has e(V1,V2) ≤ |V(G)|.
status_evidence.claim: The bound e(S,T) ≤ n for planar graphs is a stated folklore conjecture.

status_evidence.title: On Min-Bisections of Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: For every plane triangulation G there exists a minimum balanced bipartition (V1,V2) with e(V1,V2) ≤ |V(G)|, confirming the folklore conjecture for that class.
status_evidence.claim: Conjecture confirmed for the subclass of plane triangulations.

status_evidence.title: On Minimum Bisection and Related Cut Problems in Trees and Tree-Like Graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses min-bisection bounds in restricted graph classes, citing the planar folklore conjecture as open in general.
status_evidence.claim: The general planar case is still treated as an open conjecture.
